phase_name: Pre-Execution Check Failure Remediation and HOLD/HALT Handling Design
phase_japanese_name: 実行直前チェック失敗時の差し戻し・HOLD/HALTルール設計
purpose: Design procedures for handling pre-execution check failures from Phase 18-2 and 18-3, including remediation workflows, HOLD conditions with re-check procedures, and HALT termination with root cause analysis

scope_1_check_failure_classification.description: Classify Phase 18-2 and 18-3 check failures into remedial, recoverable, or terminal categories

category_1_minor_remedial_failures.description: Failures that can be fixed by configuration/timing adjustments without code changes
examples: check_2_governance_state_consistency: FAILED due to timezone offset mismatch in timestamp (fixable via clock synchronization)
check_3_timing_gate: FAILED due to execution window closed (fixable by restarting check in next authorized window)
check_7_infrastructure_readiness: FAILED due to dependency package version mismatch (fixable via package install/upgrade)
check_8_audit_trail_startup: FAILED due to log file permissions (fixable via chmod or log directory recreation)
category_1_minor_remedial_failures.remediation_action: HOLD → Apply fix → Re-execute Phase 18-[2|3] entire check suite → Re-lock evidence
category_1_minor_remedial_failures.re_check_procedure: Full 8-check re-validation (do not skip failed check only)

category_2_blocking_condition_failures.description: Failures due to explicit blocking conditions from Phase 15-7/15-8 design (e.g., prerequisite workflows not complete)
examples: check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance: FAILED due to ai_media_os Phase 43 not yet in stable operation
check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance: FAILED due to Phase 47-B dry-run not yet complete
check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance (Phase 18-3 only): FAILED due to receiver_validator_implementation_change detected
category_2_blocking_condition_failures.remediation_action: HALT or HOLD → Clear blocking condition via external workflow (Phase 43 completion, Phase 47-B execution, etc.) → Resume
category_2_blocking_condition_failures.authority_approval_required: Yes (authority decision on blocking condition clearance feasibility)
category_2_blocking_condition_failures.re_check_procedure: After blocking condition clearance confirmed, re-execute check_5 → If PASS, proceed to re-execute full check suite

category_3_authority_failure.description: Failures due to authority signature invalidity, revocation, or expiry
examples: check_4_authority_authorization: FAILED due to signer authority signature expired (valid_to_utc < now_utc)
check_4_authority_authorization: FAILED due to signer authority revoked (revocation_status=REVOKED)
check_4_authority_authorization: FAILED due to signature algorithm mismatch
category_3_authority_failure.remediation_action: HOLD → Obtain fresh signature from current authority → Re-execute Phase 18-[2|3] check suite
category_3_authority_failure.authority_approval_required: Yes (must obtain fresh signature from valid authority)
category_3_authority_failure.re_check_procedure: Phase 18-1 Phase 17 receipt confirmation remains valid; re-execute checks 2-8 with fresh authority signatures

category_4_phase18_1_receipt_failure.description: Failure of check_1_phase18_1_receipt_confirmation, indicating Phase 17 completion certificate is invalid or inconsistent
examples: check_1_phase18_1_receipt_confirmation: FAILED due to Phase 17-9 completion artifacts missing or invalid
category_4_phase18_1_receipt_failure.remediation_action: HALT → Escalate to Phase 17 remediation (cannot proceed without Phase 17 valid receipt)
category_4_phase18_1_receipt_failure.re_check_procedure: Phase 17 must be remediated and Phase 18-1 re-executed. After Phase 18-1 RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT, restart full Phase 18-2/18-3 check suite

category_5_tamper_detection_failure.description: Failures due to evidence tampering detection or integrity violations
examples: Phase 18-4 evidence lock verification: FAILED due to evidence_hash mismatch
Phase 18-4 evidence lock verification: FAILED due to audit trail integrity violation (lock record missing)
category_5_tamper_detection_failure.remediation_action: CRITICAL HALT → Security incident escalation (cannot remediate, requires investigation)
category_5_tamper_detection_failure.authority_approval_required: Yes (executive authority approval to proceed after tamper investigation)
category_5_tamper_detection_failure.re_check_procedure: No immediate re-check. Security investigation must complete. After investigation approval, Phase 18-4 must re-lock with new evidence

category_6_security_incident_failure.description: Failures due to active security events or threat conditions
examples: check_4_security_threat_conditions: FAILED due to active security threat alert (ransomware, intrusion attempt, DDoS)
check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance: FAILED due to security incident in dependent system
category_6_security_incident_failure.re_check_procedure: After incident resolution and security clearance, restart from Phase 18-2/18-3 full check suite

scope_2_hold_procedure.description: Procedures for HOLD status with defined re-check and recovery workflows

hold_scenario_1_minor_remedial_issues.trigger: One or more checks from category_1_minor_remedial_failures fail

hold_decision_options.procedure: 1) Authority documents remediation action 2) Technical team applies fix 3) Phase 18-2/18-3 entire check suite re-executed 4) Evidence re-locked in Phase 18-4

1) If check_3_timing_gate failure only: Defer execution to next authorized window (e.g., next calendar day, next scheduled maintenance window) 2) Preserve Phase 18-2/18-3 check results 3) At next window, re-execute check_3 timing validation only 4) If PASS, proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 execution
1) If remedial fix cannot be identified: Escalate to Phase 19+ design layer 2) Design new validation/mitigation approach 3) Update Phase 18-2/18-3 with new design 4) Re-execute full check suite

hold_status_outcomes.HOLD_ESCALATED_TO_DESIGN: Escalated to Phase 19+ for design enhancement

hold_scenario_2_blocking_condition_failu.trigger: check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance fails due to external prerequisite workflow not complete

hold_decision_options.procedure: 1) Authority documents blocking condition and clearance requirements 2) External workflow executes (e.g., Phase 43 completion, Phase 47-B execution) 3) Authority confirms blocking condition cleared 4) Re-execute check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance 5) If PASS, re-execute full Phase 18-2/18-3 check suite
hold_decision_options.timeline: Depends on external workflow (hours to weeks)
hold_decision_options.required_authority: Authority who can clear the blocking condition (may differ from Phase 18-2/18-3 signer)

hold_decision_options.procedure: 1) Requires executive authority approval (escalated level, not standard approval) 2) Authority documents waiver justification 3) Authority signs waiver statement 4) check_5 override to PASS with waiver note 5) Re-execute full Phase 18-2/18-3 check suite with waiver embedded
1) If blocking condition cannot be cleared and waiver denied: Halt indefinitely 2) Document reason 3) Await future conditions or explicit user intervention

hold_scenario_3_authority_failure.trigger: check_4_authority_authorization fails due to signature expiry, revocation, or invalidity

hold_decision_options.procedure: 1) Contact current valid authority (same authority as expired signature if re-authorized, or new authority) 2) Authority reviews Phase 18-2/18-3 check results and Phase 17 completion certificate 3) Authority issues fresh signature 4) Re-execute Phase 18-2/18-3 entire check suite with fresh signature 5) Evidence re-locked with fresh signature

1) If original authority is permanently revoked or unavailable: Escalate to higher authority 2) Higher authority reviews all Phase 18-2/18-3 check results and Phase 17 completion certificate 3) Higher authority issues authorization signature 4) Re-execute Phase 18-2/18-3 entire check suite with escalated authority signature

scope_3_halt_procedure.description: Procedures for HALT termination with root cause analysis and remediation workflows

halt_scenario_1_phase18_1_receipt_failur.halt_action: Execution HALTED. Cannot proceed without valid Phase 17 completion certificate.

remediation_workflow.step_1_identify_inconsistency: Review Phase 18-1 failure details. Identify which of 5 requirement groups failed (artifact presence, JSON validity, governance consistency, state consistency, dependency references)
remediation_workflow.step_2_escalate_to_phase_17_team: Escalate to Phase 17 remediation. Phase 17 artifacts must be corrected or re-certified.
remediation_workflow.step_3_phase_17_remediation: Phase 17 team executes remediation procedures from Phase 17-5 (PROCEED/HOLD/HALT handling)
remediation_workflow.step_4_phase_18_1_re_execution: After Phase 17 remediation: Re-execute Phase 18-1 receipt confirmation
remediation_workflow.step_5_restart_phase_18_2_18_3: After Phase 18-1 RECEIPT_CONFIRMED_AND_CONSISTENT: Restart full Phase 18-2/18-3 check suite

halt_scenario_2_tamper_detection.trigger: Phase 18-4 evidence lock verification detects tampering (hash mismatch, audit trail corruption, signature invalid)
halt_scenario_2_tamper_detection.halt_action: Execution HALTED. Security incident mode activated.

remediation_workflow.step_2_evidence_preservation: Preserve all evidence locks and audit trails for forensics
remediation_workflow.step_3_root_cause_analysis: Investigate tampering: accidental modification, malicious attack, system fault?
remediation_workflow.step_4_remediation: Remediation depends on root cause (restore from backup, apply security hardening, update infrastructure)
remediation_workflow.step_5_authority_approval: Executive authority approval required to proceed after investigation
remediation_workflow.step_6_phase_18_4_re_locking: After remediation and approval: Re-lock all evidence in Phase 18-4
remediation_workflow.step_7_restart: Re-execute full Phase 18-2/18-3 check suite from scratch

halt_scenario_2_tamper_detection.responsibility: Security incident response team + Executive authority

halt_scenario_3_security_incident.trigger: check_4_security_threat_conditions fails (active security threat, intrusion attempt, ransomware, DDoS)
halt_scenario_3_security_incident.halt_action: Execution HALTED. Security incident mode activated.

remediation_workflow.step_1_incident_severity_classification: Classify threat severity: INFO / WARNING / CRITICAL
remediation_workflow.step_2_incident_containment: Activate incident containment procedures (isolate affected systems, disable external access)
remediation_workflow.step_3_threat_eradication: Remove threat (malware removal, firewall rules, access revocation)
remediation_workflow.step_4_system_hardening: Apply security hardening based on threat type
remediation_workflow.step_5_forensics_and_audit: Forensic investigation to identify compromise scope and impact
remediation_workflow.step_6_authority_approval: Executive + security authority approval to resume operations
remediation_workflow.step_7_infrastructure_readiness_recheck: Re-execute check_7_infrastructure_readiness to confirm no lasting compromise
remediation_workflow.step_8_restart: Re-execute full Phase 18-2/18-3 check suite from scratch

halt_scenario_3_security_incident.responsibility: Security incident response team + Executive authority + Infrastructure team

halt_scenario_4_unresolvable_blocking_co.trigger: check_5_blocking_conditions_clearance fails and blocking condition cannot be resolved or waived
halt_scenario_4_unresolvable_blocking_co.halt_action: Execution HALTED indefinitely. Awaiting external condition resolution or explicit user intervention.

remediation_workflow.step_1_document_blocking_condition: Document blocking condition and clearance requirements
remediation_workflow.step_2_monitor_external_workflow: Monitor completion of external prerequisite workflow (Phase 43 stabilization, Phase 47-B completion, etc.)
remediation_workflow.step_3_blocking_condition_resolved: When external prerequisite is complete, authority confirms blocking condition cleared

halt_scenario_4_unresolvable_blocking_co.responsibility: Phase team managing external prerequisite + Authority

summary_table.outcome: HOLD → Clear Condition → Re-check OR Waive

phase_18_5_completion_criteria: 6 failure categories designed with remediation/HOLD/HALT procedures
HOLD procedure designed for 3 scenarios (minor remedial, blocking conditions, authority failure)
HALT procedure designed for 4 scenarios (receipt failure, tampering, security incident, unresolvable blocking)
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
